name: Barracuda Reputation Block List (b.barracudacentral.org)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted).

reliability.justification: Sender reputation list maintained by Barracuda Central; queries need a registered resolver.

brbl.title: Barracuda BRBL (DNS A answer 127.0.0.2 = listed; registered resolvers only)

terms.quote: P045 cond 2 (binding council text): URIBL, SURBL, UCEPROTECT and Barracuda are noncommercial/fair-use lists: off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared (their free-use terms recorded and allowed by legal).

brbl.notes: Quote: binding council text (P045 cond 2). Barracuda formally requires registering the querying resolver: never queried through public DoH (P045 cond 4); usable only through a registered system resolver (setting dnsbl_registered_lists). Off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared. Used by dnsbl.
brbl.licensed_alternative: A licence_allow entry recording Barracuda's terms plus a registered resolver.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P045). DNS only: the list is queried through DNS A lookups (core DoH layer or the system resolver), never over HTTP, so the provider has no HTTP host. Every DNSBL counts as ONE 'spam' family vote in P171 consensus (upstream_family 'dnsbl', P045 cond 8).
